title: My Fortune Cookie Was BLANK 🥠
description:
At the gas station on our highway, you get a fortune cookie with every fill-up, and every fortune happens by Friday. A guy found forty dollars in his tire. Geese followed a woman for a week.

Every Wednesday my grandpa and I fill up his truck and read ours out loud. Last Wednesday, mine was blank. The clerk had only heard of one blank before, fifty years ago. My grandpa's.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment BLANK if you know who you'd write yours for.
